refund.description: Explain return eligibility and prepare an exact proposal; never execute a refund.

delivery.description: Investigate shipment status and explain estimates without inventing an ETA.

invoice.description: Explain a simulated invoice and distinguish invoice total from refundable value.

warranty.description: Read product terms and separate warranty support from ordinary return eligibility.

policy.description: Answer policy or agreement questions from effective merchant-scoped evidence.
